item.name: Aggregates Residual Risk and Return Sensitivity
Get Aggregates - Residual Risk and Return Sensitivity package view

request.name: Get Aggregates - Residual Risk and Return Sensitivity package view

description.content:
The Aggregates – Residual Risk And Return Sensitivity package provides measures of the excess returns of investment in a stock, along with its volatility and relative performance aggregated by industry classification, using Morningstar’s Morningstar Global Equity Classification Structure, to give industry-wide averages on a country-by-country basis to use to benchmark a company’s financial performance relative to other companies in that industry, industry group, or sector.
The package contains the following dataset:
- Industry Aggregates - Residual Risk and Return Sensitivity
Most recent and time series data supported.

query.description:
Specifies the type of the value passed in the `id` parameter.
Morningstar Performance ID is the default identifer for the API. Use the Universe API to retrieve Performance IDs for investments in your entitled universe.
Base currency to use for investment lookup. Accepts 3‑character ISO 4217 currency codes.
Domicile to use for investment lookup. Accepts 3-character ISO 3166-1 country codes.
Exchange country to use for investment lookup. Accepts 3-character ISO 3166-1 country codes.
Exchange identifier to use for investment lookup.
Specifies the country to filter results on. Accepts 3-character ISO 3166-1 country codes. The availability of data depends on the specific data points and investments queried

variable.description:
(Required) 
Specifies the investment to query. 
Morningstar Performance ID is the default identifer for the API. Use the Universe API to retrieve Performance IDs for investments in your entitled universe.
